title: Distance along a line
prompt: Something starts at position start and moves at speed for some seconds. Return where it ends up.
signature: func solve(start: float, speed: float, seconds: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(start: float, speed: float, seconds: float) -> float:
	return start
hint: Distance travelled is speed times time. Add it to where you started.
solution:
func solve(start: float, speed: float, seconds: float) -> float:
	return start + speed * seconds
